search_text: published ZDI-09-008 ZDI-CAN-352 Apple QuickTime STSD JPEG Atom Heap Corruption Vulnerability 2009-01-21 CVE-2009-0007 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2009-0007 ['Apple'] ['Quicktime'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple QuickTime. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists in the handling of JPEG atoms embedded in STSD atoms within the function JPEG_DComponentDispatch(). When the image width data in this atom is modified, a heap corruption occurs which can be further leveraged to execute arbitrary code under the context of the current user. Apple has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
